mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_req(code, applicant_id, advisor_id, chemical_name, cas_no, category, spec, unit, qty, purpose, experiment, status, current_seq) VALUES(#{code}, #{applicantId}, #{advisorId}, #{chemicalName}, #{casNo}, #{category}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{qty}, #{purpose}, #{experiment}, #{status}, #{currentSeq})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_req WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_req SET status = 1, current_seq = #{currentSeq} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}

UPDATE purchase_req SET current_seq = #{toSeq}, status = CASE WHEN #{toSeq} = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, audit_time = CASE WHEN #{toSeq} = 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE audit_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND current_seq = #{fromSeq}
UPDATE purchase_req SET status = 3 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND current_seq = #{currentSeq}
UPDATE purchase_req SET status = 5 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 2) AND in_qty = #{inQty} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}
UPDATE purchase_req SET in_qty = in_qty + #{qty} WHERE id = #{id} AND in_qty + #{qty} <= qty
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms = #{perm}

sql.if: AND (p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.chemical_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, ua.nickname AS applicant_name, ud.nickname AS advisor_name FROM purchase_req p LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON p.applicant_id = ua.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ud ON p.advisor_id = ud.id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_req p WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_req WHERE status = 1

SELECT p.*, ua.nickname AS applicant_name, ud.nickname AS advisor_name FROM purchase_req p LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON p.applicant_id = ua.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ud ON p.advisor_id = ud.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time ASC LIMIT 20
